name: Register Mark
description: A press proof of registration targets: crosshair rings with a quartered disc at the center alternating with spoked star targets, each in a process ink.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); border-radius: @match((x + y) % 2 == 1, 50%, 0%); -webkit-mask: @match((x + y) % 2 == 1, @var(--star), @var(--tgt)); mask: @match((x + y) % 2 == 1, @var(--star), @var(--tgt)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@match((x + y) % 2 == 1, @r(0deg, 30deg), @p(0deg, 90deg))); transform: rotate(@match((x + y) % 2 == 1, @r(0deg, 30deg), @p(0deg, 90deg))); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: @match((x + y) % 2 == 1, 43%, 33%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-mask: @match((x + y) % 2 == 1, none, @var(--quad)); mask: @match((x + y) % 2 == 1, none, @var(--quad)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --tgt: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 66%, #000 66% 74%, transparent 74%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 48.4%, #000 48.4% 51.6%, transparent 51.6%) 0 50% / 100% 92% no-repeat, linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 48.4%, #000 48.4% 51.6%, transparent 51.6%) 50% 0 / 92% 100% no-repeat; --star: conic-gradient(#000 0deg 15deg, transparent 15deg 30deg, #000 30deg 45deg, transparent 45deg 60deg, #000 60deg 75deg, transparent 75deg 90deg, #000 90deg 105deg, transparent 105deg 120deg, #000 120deg 135deg, transparent 135deg 150deg, #000 150deg 165deg, transparent 165deg 180deg, #000 180deg 195deg, transparent 195deg 210deg, #000 210deg 225deg, transparent 225deg 240deg, #000 240deg 255deg, transparent 255deg 270deg, #000 270deg 285deg, transparent 285deg 300deg, #000 300deg 315deg, transparent 315deg 330deg, #000 330deg 345deg, transparent 345deg 360deg); --quad: conic-gradient(#000 0 90deg, transparent 90deg 180deg, #000 180deg 270deg, transparent 270deg); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
